Charity Event · IamMoody Event

Richard Moody’s 32nd Annual Holiday Party To Benefit The Sanneh Foundation

Tue, Dec 12, 2023 · 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM · Granada Theater

When
Tue, Dec 12, 2023 · 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Where
Granada Theater
3022 Hennepin Ave,, Minneapolis, MN
Cost
Free
More: Holiday Charity Party

 

Richard Moody’s 32nd Annual Holiday Party To Benefit The Sanneh Foundation. Once again Richard says this could be the last one, but Tony is determined to ensure it never ends as long as it can support the Sanneh Foundation.

Our nonprofit partner is The Sanneh Foundation. This award-winning charity empowers kids, improves young lives, and unites communities through advancing diversity, equity, and community well-being.
thesannehfoundation.org

We kindly ask you to bring an unwrapped gift for teens because they are typically forgotten. Donations are also accepted. All gifts and money received will be donated to The Sanneh Foundation.

SPONSOR

PARKING

Street parking and Calhoun Square (7 Corners) ramp are suggested.

THANK YOU

We hope you show up to support all his efforts to support our community.
